title: 2008 AMC 10B Problem 17
statement: A poll shows that \(70\%\) of all voters approve of the mayor’s work. On three separate occasions a pollster selects a voter at random. What is the probability that on exactly one of these three occasions the voter approves of the mayor’s work?

solutions.text:
Exactly one approval among three occasions arises in \(\binom{3}{1}=3\) ways, each with probability \((0.7)(0.3)(0.3)=0.063.\)

The total is \(3\cdot 0.063=0.189.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Exactly one approval can happen in \(3\) ordered ways
